episodes.title: Radom
episodes.summary: The Kurc Family celebrates Passover in Radom, Poland. One year later, the onset of World War II forces a devastating separation.

episodes.title: Lvov
episodes.summary: Halina and Bella start their passage to Lvov, Sol, Nechuma, and Mila must find a new home in German-occupied Radom. Addy is conscripted into Polish unit in the French Army.

episodes.title: Siberia
episodes.summary: Genek and Herta are sent on a grueling train ride. Addy escapes Europe by sea. Halina starts a new job in Soviet-occupied Lvov.

episodes.title: Casablanca
episodes.summary: Mila does everything to protect young Felicia. Halina, Jakob, and Bella face new danger in Lvov. Addy searches for Eliska in Morocco.

episodes.title: Ilha Das Flores
episodes.summary: Halina, Jakob, and Bella search for those missing in Lvov. Addy and Eliska attempt to enter Brazil. Genek faces a Siberian winter and a question of faith. Sol and Nechuma observe Rosh Hashanah.

episodes.title: Warsaw
episodes.summary: With Sol and Nechuma in danger, Halina attempts to find refuge for her parents; Mila learns to assimilate in Warsaw; Bella searches for solace at the AVL Factory; Jakob faces life alone in the Radom ghetto.

episodes.title: Monte Cassino
episodes.summary: Halina and Adam prepare for impending violence in Warsaw. Genek embarks on a dangerous mission. Addy struggles to move on with the unknown fate of his family.

episodes.title: Rio
episodes.summary: Halina's strength and hope are put to the test. Addy builds a new life in Rio. The end of the war triggers the Kurc family's final search for answers.
